Watch the latest trailer for Sublustrum, a psychological adventure exploring memory, perception, and the subconscious. The trailer reveals Nicholas Boulton as the voice of the Professor and showcases new locations, strange machinery, and intricate puzzles built around observation, experimentation, and careful listening.

In Sublustrum, you search for your missing scientist brother while descending into a surreal world where sound, mechanisms, and fragmented memories become part of the mystery.
